{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Keep only the row with highest sample_seq per patient
# First, sort by patient_id and sample_seq (descending)
df_sorted = df.sort_values(['patient_id', 'sample_seq'], ascending=[True, False])

# Then drop duplicates, keeping the first (highest sample_seq) row per patient
df_dedup = df_sorted.drop_duplicates(subset=['patient_id'], keep='first')

# Now filter to treatment arm
treatment_dedup = df_dedup[df_dedup['arm'] == 'treatment']

treatment_responded = treatment_dedup['responded'].sum()
treatment_total = len(treatment_dedup)
fraction_responded = treatment_responded / treatment_total

print(f"Unique patients in treatment arm: {treatment_total}")
print(f"Responded: {treatment_responded}")
print(f"Fraction responded: {fraction_responded}")"}
